annotations.text:
One page, four artboards. An artboard can be 8000 px tall at most, so the home page is cut into four parts. Read them downwards.

The page follows the Developer Cowork loop: Plan, Direct, Review. The backlog in Plan is marked "coming next" and its picture is a drawing, not a screenshot.

The phone artboard is the top part at 390 px wide. It mirrors the desktop artboard, so edit the desktop one.

Tweaks on each artboard: Theme (Dark or Light) and which system the Download button names.
